input.rationale: Section 4.1 only allows the Agreement to be stopped from auto-renewing on 90 days' notice; it does not give the Company an express mid-term convenience exit, and HDI's notice may fix any Termination Date, so HDI can walk away mid-term. Section 4.2(a) then charges the Company an uncapped Termination Payment equal to half of (twelve months' Net Sales less $800,000). We therefore (i) add an express Company convenience termination on ninety (90) days' notice (within the 60–90 day fallback band), (ii) confine HDI's no-cause termination to the end of the then-current term, retaining the mutual 90-day notice, and (iii) cap the Termination Payment at the amounts payable to HDI under Section 3.1 for the three months preceding the Termination Date, an ascertainable three-months-of-fees ceiling that leaves the 4.2(b) zero-floor and 4.2(c) instalment mechanics intact. This lands the clause at the fallback; the preferred 30-day notice and pro-rata refund are not pursued.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We added an express right for the Company to exit for convenience on ninety (90) days' notice and confined HDI's no-cause termination to the end of the then-current term. We also capped the Termination Payment at the amounts payable to HDI under Section 3.1 for the three months before the Termination Date, so the exit cost is ascertainable. This is our fallback position on termination for convenience.

ops.newText: 4.1 Term; Termination. This Agreement shall be effective as of that date (the "Effective Date") the Site becomes fully operational as set forth in writing and executed by both Parties and shall continue for a period of one (1) year from the Effective Date. This Agreement shall be automatically renewed for an additional one year period on each anniversary of the Effective Date, unless terminated by either Party hereto upon ninety (90) days written notice to the other, provided that termination by HDI shall be effective only at the end of the then-current term. Such notice shall specify the date on which this Agreement is to be terminated (the "Termination Date"). The Company may also terminate this Agreement for convenience at any time upon ninety (90) days written notice to HDI specifying the Termination Date.
